dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: I understand what you mean, Madam. But this is a bank, not a charity. I need to confirm a few things before approving this loan...

dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: If I'm not mistaken, you intend to mortgage the apartment that the Armory Palace assigned to Mr. Karelin, to finance the production of something known as... "Snezhda"?

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: That's right, Mr. Manager. This is a historic opportunity! Mr. Sherbatov, who sold me the recipe, promised that there's a guaranteed fortune to be made following it.

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: We all know how popular the fizzy drinks the Fontainians have intended are abroad. And if they can have their Fonta, why can't we have our Snezhda?

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: I've even brought a sample with me. Want a taste? A single sip's more than enough to freeze your throat.

dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll... put the property rights nightmare around the apartment aside for now, and simply say this.

dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: Madam, one need only crack open a window and open one's mouth to experience one's throat freezing over. As such, I can't think of a reason to approve this loan.

dialogues.speaker: Karelin
dialogues.text: Exactly, Mr. Manager! That's what I told her back at home, too! I just knew she didn't have the talent to...

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: Shush, you! How much Mora do you get from the Armory Palace a month, anyway? We have three other mouths to feed, you know! Where do you think all that money's going to come from?

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: Every time I even try to raise this topic, you stare at your newspaper and pretend you can't hear me! Do you want to give our children away to the Fatui or something?

dialogues.speaker: Karelin
dialogues.text: Well, joining the Fatui wouldn't be a bad thing, precisely...

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: So you want to spend the rest of your life fiddling with boxes of craps, huh? Be my guest, but don't drag our kids into this!

dialogues.speaker: Yurova
dialogues.text: Trust me, Mr. Manager. All I need is a month... no, a week of Snezhda production, and I'll make the principal back for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: You're the sixth person to assure me as such this month. The previous person wanted to plant Grainfruit in the snowfields, and the one before them wanted to package Prime Ice as medicine and sell it to Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Izmailov
dialogues.text: Do you want to know what they all have in common? They're all on the debt collection agents' blacklist right now. I'm sorry, Ma'am, but I cannot approve this loan.

dialogues.speaker: Karelin
dialogues.text: Come on, love, why don't we... head back for now? If this really doesn't work out, I'll apply for another night shift at the factory tomorrow... We'll find a way, I'm sure of it...
